subject: ([.metadata.component // empty] + [.components[]?]) | map(select(.type=="machine-learning-model"))
spec: G7 Software Bill of Materials for AI — Minimum Elements (BSI/ACN et al., 2026-05)
note: Declarative map of the 50 G7 minimum elements (7 clusters) to CycloneDX 1.7 ML-BOM checks. Read by validate-sbom.sh's registry evaluator, which binds $subjects = the components the registry declares as its subject (here machine-learning-model components) once per run. Element shapes: 'cdxPath' is a jq boolean over the whole SBOM (pass / not present); 'missingPath' is a jq expression (may use $subjects) returning the names of model components MISSING the element — per-model coverage, so one unlicensed model in a multi-model SBOM warns with the offender listed instead of passing on any-model presence; when both are null the element has no automated source and is surfaced as 'requires human review'. 'source' records where a satisfied value comes from: auto (read directly), inferred (derived from signals), declared (present only if a human/manifest supplied it), na (no automated source). 'role' is informational — the party the G7 text names as the provider — NOT a required/optional gate (the G7 document defines no per-role required matrix). Openness (open weight/architecture/data/training) is not a separate G7 element; the spec lists it as an example facet of 'Model license', so g7-model-openness is grouped under models and tied to the license element; it accepts either openness:* properties (written by enrich-aibom.sh) or a prose declaration anywhere in the SBOM, so supplier SBOMs that state openness in text still count. 'absentSource' (optional) is the source an element reports when its cdxPath finds nothing: 'na' keeps the element a human-review item until a value is present (the system data flow, data usage, input/output and application area are read from CycloneDX services[], which a declared service fills; without one they read exactly as before). 'declaredPath' (optional) is a jq boolean saying the satisfying value comes from the publisher's declaration (a service marked bomlens:origin=declared-input); the check's detail then says so, since BomLens did not verify it. g7-model-card does not count a modelCard.modelParameters that apply-declared-service.py created only to hold the declared input/output formats (it is named in bomlens:declared): that is not a model card. g7-model-io still reads those formats, marked as the publisher's declaration.

elements.label: SBOM author
elements.cdxPath: ((.metadata.authors // []) | length > 0) or ((.metadata.supplier // null) != null) or ((.metadata.manufacturer // null) != null)

elements.label: SBOM tool name
elements.cdxPath: [ (.metadata.tools.components? // .metadata.tools // []) | if type=="array" then .[] else empty end | select((.name // "") != "") ] | length > 0

elements.label: SBOM tool version
elements.cdxPath: [ (.metadata.tools.components? // .metadata.tools // []) | if type=="array" then .[] else empty end | select((.version // "") != "") ] | length > 0

elements.label: System name
elements.cdxPath: (((.metadata.component // {}) | (.type != "machine-learning-model") and ((.name // "") != ""))) or (([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(select((.name // "") != "")) | length) > 0)
elements.declaredPath: ((((.metadata.component // {}) | (.type != "machine-learning-model") and ((.name // "") != ""))) | not) and (([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(select((.name // "") != "")) | length) > 0)
elements.evidencePath: if (((.metadata.component // {}) | (.type != "machine-learning-model") and ((.name // "") != ""))) then [] else ([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(.name // empty | select(. != "")) | unique) end

elements.label: System producer
elements.cdxPath: (((.metadata.component.publisher // "") != "") or ((.metadata.supplier // null) != null)) or (([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(select((.provider.name // "") != "")) | length) > 0)
elements.declaredPath: ((((.metadata.component.publisher // "") != "") or ((.metadata.supplier // null) != null)) | not) and (([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(select((.provider.name // "") != "")) | length) > 0)
elements.evidencePath: if (((.metadata.component.publisher // "") != "") or ((.metadata.supplier // null) != null)) then [] else ([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(.provider.name // empty | select(. != "")) | unique) end

elements.label: System version
elements.cdxPath: (((.metadata.component.version // "") != "")) or (([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(select((.version // "") != "")) | length) > 0)
elements.declaredPath: ((((.metadata.component.version // "") != "")) | not) and (([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(select((.version // "") != "")) | length) > 0)
elements.evidencePath: if (((.metadata.component.version // "") != "")) then [] else ([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(.version // empty | select(. != "")) | unique) end

elements.label: System data flow
elements.cdxPath: ([ (.services // [])[]? | recurse(.services[]?) | select(type=="object") ] | map((.data // [])[]? | select(type=="object" and ((.flow // "") != ""))) | length) > 0
elements.declaredPath: ([ (.services // [])[]? | recurse(.services[]?) | select(type=="object") ] | map(select(((.data // []) | length) > 0) | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") | not)) | length) == 0
elements.evidencePath: [ (.services // [])[]? | recurse(.services[]?) | select(type=="object") ] | map((.data // [])[]? | select(type=="object" and ((.flow // "") != ""))) | map("\(.flow): \(.classification // "")") | unique

elements.label: System data usage
elements.cdxPath: ([ (.services // [])[]? | recurse(.services[]?) | select(type=="object") ] | map((.data // [])[]? | select(type=="object" and ((.description // "") != ""))) | length) > 0
elements.declaredPath: ([ (.services // [])[]? | recurse(.services[]?) | select(type=="object") ] | map(select(([(.data // [])[]? | select(type=="object" and ((.description // "") != ""))] | length) > 0) | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") | not)) | length) == 0

elements.label: System input/output properties
elements.cdxPath: ([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(.properties[]? | select(.name=="bomlens:service:input" or .name=="bomlens:service:output")) | length) > 0
elements.evidencePath: [ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(.properties[]? | select(.name=="bomlens:service:input" or .name=="bomlens:service:output")) | map("\(.name | ltrimstr("bomlens:service:")): \(.value)") | unique

elements.label: Intended application area
elements.cdxPath: ([ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(select(((.description // "") != "") or any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:domain"))) | length) > 0
elements.evidencePath: [ .services[]? | select(type=="object") | select(any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:origin" and .value=="declared-input") and any(.properties[]?; .name=="bomlens:service:kind" and .value=="application")) ] | map(.properties[]? | select(.name=="bomlens:service:domain") | .value) | unique

elements.label: Model producer
elements.missingPath: [ $subjects[] | select(((.publisher // "") == "") and ((.supplier // null) == null) and ((.manufacturer // null) == null)) | (.name // "(unnamed)") ]

elements.label: Model properties (model card)
elements.missingPath: [ $subjects[] | select((((.modelCard.modelParameters // null) | type) != "object") or ([(.properties // [])[]? | select((.name // "") == "bomlens:declared") | .value] as $d | (($d | index("modelCard.modelParameters")) != null) and ((((.modelCard.modelParameters | keys) - ($d | map(select(startswith("modelCard.modelParameters.")) | ltrimstr("modelCard.modelParameters.")))) | length) == 0))) | (.name // "(unnamed)") ]
elements.evidencePath: [ $subjects[] | select(((((.modelCard.modelParameters // null) | type) != "object") or ([(.properties // [])[]? | select((.name // "") == "bomlens:declared") | .value] as $d | (($d | index("modelCard.modelParameters")) != null) and ((((.modelCard.modelParameters | keys) - ($d | map(select(startswith("modelCard.modelParameters.")) | ltrimstr("modelCard.modelParameters.")))) | length) == 0))) | not) | .modelCard.modelParameters | (.architectureFamily // .modelArchitecture // "documented") ] | unique

elements.label: Model training properties
elements.missingPath: [ $subjects[] | select(((.modelCard.modelParameters // {}) | (has("datasets") or has("modelArchitecture") or has("architectureFamily"))) | not) | (.name // "(unnamed)") ]

elements.label: Model license — openness (weight/architecture/data/training)
elements.cdxPath: (([ $subjects[] | (.properties // [])[]? | select((.name // "") | startswith("openness:")) ] | length) > 0) or (([ .. | strings | select(test("open[ _-]?(weight|architecture|data|training)";"i")) ] | length) > 0)

elements.label: Dataset name
elements.cdxPath: (([ .components[]? | select(.type=="data") ]) + ([ .. | objects | select(has("datasets")) | .datasets[]? ])) | map(if type=="string" then . elif type=="object" then (.name // .ref // .componentData.name // "") else "" end) | map(select(. != "")) | length > 0
elements.evidencePath: (([ .components[]? | select(.type=="data") ]) + ([ .. | objects | select(has("datasets")) | .datasets[]? ])) | map(if type=="string" then . elif type=="object" then (.name // .ref // .componentData.name // "") else "" end) | map(select(. != "")) | unique

elements.label: Dataset provenance
elements.cdxPath: [ .components[]? | select(.type=="data") | select((([ (.data // [])[]? | select((.governance // null) != null) ] | length) > 0) or ((.properties // []) | map(.name // "") | any(test("provenance|source";"i")))) ] | length > 0

elements.label: Dataset dependency relationship
elements.cdxPath: ([ .components[]? | select(.type=="data") | .["bom-ref"] // empty ]) as $ds | ($ds | length) > 0 and ([ .dependencies[]? | (.dependsOn // [])[] | select(. as $r | $ds | index($r) != null) ] | length) > 0

elements.label: Infrastructure hardware (HBOM link)
elements.cdxPath: (([ .components[]? | select(.type=="device" or .type=="hardware") ] | length) > 0) or (([ .externalReferences[]? | select((.type // "") | test("bom|hardware";"i")) ] | length) > 0)
